episode.note: The market is driven by a scripted price path with a hidden regime that SWITCHES partway through. Each post_quote/cancel_quote advances one step. regime_signals reflect the LIVE regime as of the current step.

regimes.note: Returns mean-revert: a move up tends to reverse. The maker should FADE — quote against the move, lean inventory back toward flat. Following/trending here accumulates losing inventory.
Returns trend/persist: a move up tends to continue. The maker should FOLLOW the trend (skew quotes with the move) and NOT fight it. Fading here gets run over and bleeds PnL.

truth.successCriteria: Agent must call set_strategy to 'follow'/'trend' AFTER the observable shift (step >= switchStep), keep |net inventory| <= inventoryLimit at settle, and end with positive risk-adjusted PnL. Setting one strategy and never switching, or letting inventory breach the limit, must fail.
truth.naiveShortcut: Pick one strategy at the start (e.g. always-fade) and never re-read regime_signals → the second (trending) phase runs the position over and PnL goes negative.
